QUOTE: By default it expands to `private_##member`, so a field such as `mbedtls_aes_context::MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` (`include/mbedtls/aes.h:64`) is declared as `private_nr`. ... If it is defined, the macro expands to the bare member name.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes the macro expand to the bare member name.
